notes.title: WARRABBIT UPDATE
notes.notes:
Good news, evereyone!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830122/b1525a3eb2ef9c213c85ba6b4d5621dff20a190d.png

Here come the first Voxel Tanks update - WARRABBIT! Command your tank, destroy enemies and try not to be destroyed by giant war mechs! You are the warrabbit! You have paws, soft ears and 120mm tank gun!

+ new enemies
+ new levels
+ new achievements
+ bugfixes (at 8 lvl, yes)
+ new bugs (probably)
